title: Etna Input Stream
description: Output format produced by a workload's `sample` capability. A JSON array where each element is one generated input together with optional per-input metadata. Consumers of the `test` capability (including the `Cross` mode) read this same shape.

value.description: Opaque representation of the generated input. The exact shape is workload-specific; producers and consumers must agree on the encoding (e.g. s-expression, JSON string, pretty printer output).

time.description: Wall-clock time spent generating this input, as a human-readable duration (e.g. "123ns", "1.5ms", "2s"). Parsed with the `parse_duration` crate.

status.description: Optional status for this individual input if the producer ran a property against it (e.g. when a sampler is also checking).

features.description: Optional runtime observations attached to this input (e.g. coverage bits, stat counters). Free-form per workload.
